title: ObjectNumber
description: Fiori object number (sap.m.ObjectNumber look): emphasized number with unit, semantic states, inverted badge, large and active variants.

usage.summary: Display a business amount or quantity together with its unit and optional semantic state.
useWhen: Help users read and compare business amounts or quantities without separating their units.
Keep the unit beside the amount unless every row shares it, each cell contains one amount, and the column header stays visible.
Use emphasized for the most important number; set emphasized={false} when all numbers are equally important.

avoidWhen.when: Show the primary KPI and its supporting values above a chart in a card.
Describe an object state in words or with an icon rather than an amount.
Show how much of a running process is complete on a 0–100% scale.
